issue.title: Add a Resume suppressed hand-off recovery action for latched hijacks

task_type_fields.proposal:
When a latched hijack applies at a hand-off boundary (staged pipe/plan/questions hand-off, gate follow-up, or monitor follow-up), the ledger records `suppressed_followup = {kind, ref}` and the continuation brief names the suppressed hand-off and its payload path as untrusted context. Recovery offers Continue/Escalate/Restart/Dismiss (and Re-run for monitors), but there is no action that simply resumes the suppressed hand-off as it was staged.

Proposal: add a "Resume suppressed hand-off" recovery action that adopts the recorded staged payload (or launches the recorded gate/monitor follow-up) in the held workspace exactly once, CAS-pinned on hijack id and revision like the other recovery actions, with the decision in sase-core's recovery-preview rows.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1t2 (plan:202611/agent_hijack_dependability.md) listed this recovery action as a deferred follow-up for its land phase; the epic delivered suppression and recording of the hand-off, not a dedicated resume path. Proposed by the plan's land phase sase-1t2.14 (not recorded there); filed by the sase-1t2 land agent.

issue.creation_reason: Deferred by epic sase-1t2's land phase and never recorded; the sase-1t2 land agent files it so the resume path stays a tracked idea.
